title: TinyStories validation cross-entropy
description: Every 50 training steps, pretrain.py samples 10 validation batches and averages their next-token cross-entropy losses. Each batch contains 200 sequences of 256 tokens. gpt.py computes log-sum-exp minus the target logit, averaged across batch and sequence positions.
formula: val_loss = mean over validation batches of mean(logsumexp(logits) − target logit)
note: The protocol above describes standalone pretraining defaults. Agentic research uses a separate fixed 200-step screening protocol: batch 32, context 256, 10 validation batches every 50 steps, seed 42, identical sampled train/validation windows across candidates. Each research session starts with a fresh baseline and comparison series. These scores are not directly comparable with historical 2,000-step W&B runs. Source and original data remain unchanged.
